description: SWARM Utilities - UUIDs, hashes, base64 and URL encoding, passwords, timestamp conversion. Pick one with `op`. Instant, no AI. Returns JSON (uuids, hash, encoded/decoded or password). $0.02. Pays in USDC on Base via x402 when SWARM_WALLET_KEY is set (quote checked against SWARM_MAX_USD first; charged only on success). On failure it says whether you were charged and if a retry is safe; it never retries on its own.
